opening.argument: The offer ties paid token packages to a stated doubling within two to three months: for €140, viewers are told they receive 1,000 tokens and later 2,000, with the speaker saying, "you double your money." Buying two packs is linked to four splits, alongside claims of a very large one-year profit. The return claims are reinforced by team-based commissions and recruitment: viewers are told that "the other way of getting money is if you get people in your team" and can become a free rookie and bring in friends. The invitation to click the link and the prediction that the coin may double in price support participation in the offer. Advice to invest only what one can afford and the prediction's qualification do not remove the package-return claims.
